title: Sarbacher's secret atomic lab in Washington DC

tellings.quote: It was published in the paper that he had asked for a renewal of a permit to pursue atomic research at this residential address in Washington DC,

plain: A researcher named Jan Lundquist, on Jesse Michels' podcast, says that in the 1950s a man named Robert Sarbacher ran atomic research out of a house in a residential part of Washington DC. According to Lundquist, a newspaper reported that Sarbacher had asked to renew a permit to do atomic research at that home address. She tells it as a sign that secret, serious scientific work was going on in unexpected places in that era.
